description:
We are a paint by numbers brand looking to work with affiliates to promote our high quality paint by number kits. Each kit comes with everything you need to create beautiful artwork including paints and brushes. With over 1000+ designs to choose from, we have something for everyone. Anyone with an online audience is welcome to apply! 

Please do not apply if you are a coupon website.
payout_period: Affiliates are paid biweekly through Paypal
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Craftoria! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use a product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

An affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may also advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, and you will get a commission amount, which is calculated based on the commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on the order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of the commission is displayed in the Commission tab; any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Promotion

To maintain a fair environment for all partners and uphold the integrity of the brand, paid advertising is not allowed within our affiliate program.

Affiliates are strictly prohibited from running paid search or display ads that promote their affiliate links. This includes bidding on:


  • Generic category terms (e.g., “paint by numbers,” “DIY art kits”)
  • Branded terms (e.g., “Craftoria,” “Craftoria kits,” “Craftoria discount”


We encourage all affiliates to focus on organic promotional strategies, such as:


  • Sharing content on your personal or business social media platforms
  • Creating original videos, blog posts, or product reviews
  • Promoting to your email subscribers or established audience


Violating this policy may result in the forfeiture of earned commissions and/or removal from the affiliate program.

Boosting your own original content, such as Instagram Reels or TikTok videos, is allowed and encouraged.


6. Network

If the Network tab is activated, the affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission, which depends on the merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link, and any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.


7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them, so we can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies Day is stated on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (there’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


8. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting Sponsors@craftoria.com.
